_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2011 10-K): Our businesses are highly cyclical, in addition to experiencing some less significant seasonal effects.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2011 10-K): Our businesses are highly cyclical, in addition to experiencing some less significant seasonal effects.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +114% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.60; conservative 2yr -24%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.0-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS -11.3%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2012-12-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (42.4% downside to Bear $32 / +-36.9% upside to Bull $35) | Adj composite 1.15 vs market 3.75: gap -2.60 [OVERVALUED] | +114% above the EPP floor $26 (6x FY12E $4.32) | Conservative 2-yr case: -24.0% total (-12.0%/yr) | At 12.8x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $73 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +23.4% and Intermediates & Derivatives +15.2% operating income in Q3 2012, forward revenues -9.9% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
